description: Create CMS Group content type and resource-limits component, update Flow content type with group relation. Backward compatible - existing flows work without group.
steps: Create /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/dynamic-grouped-workers-phase1/cms/src/components/config/resource-limits.json component with attributes: cpuRequest (string, default '100m', regex ^[0-9]+m?$), cpuLimit (string, default '500m'), memoryRequest (string, default '128Mi', regex ^[0-9]+(Mi|Gi)$), memoryLimit (string, default '512Mi').

Create /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/dynamic-grouped-workers-phase1/cms/src/api/group/content-types/group/schema.json with: kind collectionType, draftAndPublish true, attributes: groupId (uid, required, unique, regex ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$, maxLength 64), name (string, required, maxLength 128), description (text), enabled (boolean, default true), scalingMode (enumeration [static, dynamic, ephemeral], default dynamic, required), minReplicas (integer, min 0, default 0, required), maxReplicas (integer, min 1, default 10, required), scaleDownDelaySeconds (integer, min 60, default 300), startupTimeoutSeconds (integer, min 5, default 30), resources (component config.resource-limits), connections (relation manyToMany to api::connection.connection). NOTE: flows relation is intentionally OMITTED - flow-to-group assignment is via flow's group field, not group's flows list.

Update /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/dynamic-grouped-workers-phase1/cms/src/api/flow/content-types/flow/schema.json: add 'group' attribute with type relation, relation manyToOne, target api::group.group. This is the flow's FK to group.

Update /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/dynamic-grouped-workers-phase1/cms/src/api/connection/content-types/connection/schema.json: add 'groups' attribute for the inverse manyToMany relation from group.connections.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build passes from cms/ directory
Group content type has all fields from design: groupId, name, description, enabled, scalingMode, minReplicas, maxReplicas, scaleDownDelaySeconds, startupTimeoutSeconds, resources, connections
Flow content type has optional 'group' relation (manyToOne to group)
resource-limits component exists with cpu/memory fields
scalingMode enumeration has exactly: static, dynamic, ephemeral
groupId has regex validation matching Go ValidateGroup
No flows relation on group (intentional per design)
